definitions.explanation: The fibrous tissue that forms over a wound after healing. Used as the formal medical term for scars, in contrast to the more everyday word {傷跡|きずあと}.

examples.japanese: {手術後|しゅじゅつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{瘢痕|はんこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: A scar remained after the surgery.

examples.japanese: {瘢痕|はんこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}たなく→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took half a year for the scar to become less noticeable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火傷|やけど}→火傷：04077_yakedo⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{瘢痕|はんこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{形成外科|けいせいげか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I visited a plastic surgeon to treat the scar from a burn.

notes:
The formal medical term for scar tissue. In everyday conversation, Japanese speakers typically use ⟦{傷跡|きずあと}→傷跡：14893_kizuato⟧ (scar) or ⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧ (mark), while {瘢痕|はんこん} is reserved for clinical and written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瘢痕|はんこん}⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧: scar tissue
- {瘢痕|はんこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: a scar remains
- {瘢痕|はんこん}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: scar treatment
- {肥厚性|ひこうせい}{瘢痕|はんこん}: hypertrophic scar
- ケロイド{瘢痕|はんこん}: keloid scar

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傷跡|きずあと}→傷跡：14893_kizuato⟧: scar — everyday word for a visible scar on the skin
- {痕|あと}: mark, trace — general word for any mark left behind
- ケロイド: keloid — a specific type of raised, overgrown scar tissue
